001package edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.service;
002
003import androidx.lifecycle.LiveData;
004import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.PinDao;
005import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.dao.TrackDao;
006import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Pin;
007import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.Track;
008import edu.cnm.deepdive.trailtrack.model.entity.User;
009import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Completable;
010import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Scheduler;
011import io.reactivex.rxjava3.core.Single;
012import io.reactivex.rxjava3.schedulers.Schedulers;
013import java.time.Instant;
014import java.util.List;
015import javax.inject.Inject;
016import javax.inject.Singleton;
017
018/**
019 * Repository class to manage data operations related to Pins and Tracks.
020 * Provides methods to interact with the persistence layer through DAOs and
021 * integrates with the Google Sign-In service for user-specific operations.
022 * Utilizes dependency injection for instantiation and RxJava for handling asynchronous operations.
023 */
024@Singleton
025public class PinRepository {
026
027  private final PinDao pinDao;
028  private final TrackDao trackDao;
029  private final Scheduler scheduler;
030  private final GoogleSignInService googleSignInService;
031
032  /**
033   * Constructs a new instance of the PinRepository class. This repository encapsulates
034   * data operations related to Pins and Tracks, bridging the persistence layer via DAOs
035   * and integrating with user authentication through the Google Sign-In service.
036   * The class leverages dependency injection for its dependencies.
037   *
038   * @param pinDao               Data access object for performing operations on Pin entities.
039   * @param trackDao             Data access object for performing operations on Track entities.
040   * @param googleSignInService  Service for handling Google Sign-In operations and user-specific tasks.
041   */
042  @Inject
043  PinRepository(PinDao pinDao, TrackDao trackDao, GoogleSignInService googleSignInService) {
044    this.pinDao = pinDao;
045    this.trackDao = trackDao;
046    this.googleSignInService = googleSignInService;
047    scheduler = Schedulers.io();
048  }
049
050  /**
051   * Saves the specified {@code Pin} object to the database. If the pin already exists
052   * (determined by a nonzero ID), it updates the existing record and sets the modification timestamp
053   * to the current time. Otherwise, it inserts the new {@code Pin} into the database.
054   *
055   * @param pin The {@code Pin} object to be saved or updated. Must not be null.
056   * @return A {@code Single<Pin>} representing the saved or updated {@code Pin} object.
057   */
058  public Single<Pin> save(Pin pin) {
059    return (pin.getId() != 0)
060      ? Completable.fromAction(() -> pin.setModifiedOn(Instant.now()))
061        .andThen(pinDao.update(pin))
062        .toSingle(() -> pin)
063        .subscribeOn(scheduler)
064      : pinDao
065        .insertAndReturn(pin)
066        .subscribeOn(scheduler);
067  }
068
069  /**
070   * Retrieves a {@code Pin} object identified by the specified unique ID from the database.
071   *
072   * @param id The unique identifier of the {@code Pin} to fetch. Must be a positive number.
073   * @return A {@code LiveData<Pin>} instance representing the {@code Pin} entity with the given ID.
074   */
075  public LiveData<Pin> get(long id) {
076    return pinDao.selectById(id);
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Deletes the specified {@code Pin} object from the database.
081   * This operation is asynchronous and will execute on the specified scheduler.
082   *
083   * @param pin The {@code Pin} object to be removed from the database. Must not be null.
084   * @return A {@code Completable} representing the result of the delete operation. It
085   *         completes successfully when the {@code Pin} is deleted or emits an error if the operation fails.
086   */
087  public Completable remove(Pin pin) {
088    return pinDao
089        .delete(pin)
090        .subscribeOn(scheduler);
091  }
092
093  /**
094   * Retrieves a list of {@code Pin} entities associated with the specified {@code User},
095   * ordered by their creation timestamp in ascending order.
096   *
097   * @param user The {@code User} whose pins are to be fetched. Must not be null.
098   * @return A {@code LiveData<List<Pin>>} containing the list of pins for the given user.
099   */
100  public LiveData<List<Pin>> getAll(User user) {
101    return pinDao.selectByCreatedOnAsc(user.getId());
102  }
103
104  /**
105   * Retrieves a list of {@code Pin} objects associated with the specified {@code User}.
106   *
107   * @param user The {@code User} whose associated pins are to be retrieved. Must not be null.
108   * @return A {@code LiveData<List<Pin>>} containing the list of pins linked to the specified user.
109   */
110  public LiveData<List<Pin>> getAllForUser(User user) {
111    return pinDao.selectByUserId(user.getId());
112  }
113
114  /**
115   * Retrieves a list of {@code Pin} entities associated with the specified {@code Track}.
116   *
117   * @param track The {@code Track} whose associated pins are to be fetched. Must not be null.
118   * @return A {@code LiveData<List<Pin>>} containing the list of pins linked to the specified track.
119   */
120  public LiveData<List<Pin>> getAllForTrack(Track track) {
121    return pinDao.selectByTrackId(track.getId());
122  }
123
124  /**
125   * Retrieves a list of all {@code Track} entities stored in the database.
126   * The tracks are ordered alphabetically by their name.
127   *
128   * @return A {@code LiveData<List<Track>>} containing all tracks in the database.
129   */
130  public LiveData<List<Track>> getAllTracks(){
131    return trackDao.selectAll();
132  }
133
134}
